vii_gross_w_plus_stratum.note: Frobenius forces nothing here, so this test can fail. The orbits with w = +1 and L(f,1) = 0 have even analytic rank >= 2, which the functional equation does not force either; they are the sharpest cases in the range.

iv_permutation_test.withdrawn_because: The observed statistic is forced to 0 and cannot take any other value, so the small p-value measures nothing. Our base point E_0 has j = 1728 in F_p, so Frobenius fixes e_{E_0}; F commutes with the Brandt matrices and acts by w on the f-component, whence pi_f e_{E_0} = w pi_f e_{E_0}, which gives pi_f e_{E_0} = 0 whenever w = -1, at every prime. Independently, w = -1 forces an odd functional equation, so L(f,1) = 0 and Gross predicts invisibility from any base point. This entry is retained as a descriptive record and is excluded from controls_ok; the informative test is positive_controls.vii_gross_w_plus_stratum, where visibility is not forced.
